name: fspecial
expr: h = fspecial("average", 3); r1 = double(numel(h)); h2 = fspecial('disk',2); d2n = numel(h2); d2c = h2(3,3); d2corner = h2(1,1); d2edge = h2(3,1); d2off = h2(2,2); d2sum = sum(h2(:)); h3 = fspecial('disk',3); d3n = numel(h3); d3c = h3(4,4); h5 = fspecial('disk',5); d5n = numel(h5); d5c = h5(6,6); u = fspecial('unsharp'); un = numel(u); usum = sum(u(:)); uc = u(2,2); ued = u(1,2); ucorn = u(1,1); u5 = fspecial('unsharp',0.5); u5c = u5(2,2); u5ed = u5(1,2);
comment: Sig: h = fspecial(type, params). DEEP-PROBE c160: fspecial('disk',r) now computes MATLAB R2025b's EXACT sub-pixel area-coverage integral, not the prior linear-taper approximation. Bit-exact across r=1..10: disk(2)=5x5 sum=1 centre 0.0795774715, corner 0, mid-edge 0.0381149714, h(2,2)=0.0783813542; disk(3) centre 0.0353677651; disk(5)=11x11 centre 0.0127323954; size now 2*ceil(r-0.5)+1. c161: added the 'unsharp' filter type (was 'unknown filter type'): the 3x3 h=[-a a-1 -a; a-1 a+5 a-1; -a a-1 -a]/(a+1), alpha in [0,1] default 0.2 -> centre 4.3333..., edge-mid -0.6667, corner -0.1667, sum=1; alpha=0.5 -> centre 3.6667, edge -0.3333. 'average'/'gaussian'/'laplacian'/'log'/'sobel'/'prewitt' unchanged; 'motion' still missing (deferred). covers:[fspecial].
